k-12.title: Ubani owenzayo? Izihloko ezishiyiwe
k-12.goal: Thola ukuthi kuhloselwe bani engxoxweni lapho izihloko zishiywe, uthole umugqa osala ungacacile, bese ubhala ingxoxo yakho emfushane lapho inkomba isakhombisa ukuthi ubani.
k-12.material:
수미 no-태호 basebenza ehhovisi elilodwa. Bazama ukuthinta u-부장님 wabo (inhloko yomnyango). 비서 usho unobhala wenhloko.

수미: 부장님한테 전화했어요?
태호: 네, 했는데 안 받으세요.
수미: 비서한테는 물어봤어요?
태호: 네, 물어봤더니 지금 회의 중이시래요.
k-12.s.s1.r.b: Umkhulumi ngeke asebenzise ukuphela okuhloniphekile -시- ngokwakhe.
k-12.s.s1.r.c: 수미 akayena okhulunywa ngaye; ukuphela okuhloniphekile nakho kukhomba othile ophakeme.
k-12.s.s1.r.d: Unobhala ungumuntu ophendulile, hhayi umuntu osemhlanganweni.
k-12.s.s1.explain: U-'회의 중이시래요' unoku--시- ohloniphekile, omaka isihloko njengomuntu okufanele ahlonishwe: u-부장님.
k-12.s.s2.hint.0: Thola ukuthi u-태호 wabuza bani emugqeni wangaphambilini.
k-12.s.s2.r.b: 태호 wabuza unobhala, hhayi inhloko, futhi inhloko yiyona ematasa emhlanganweni.
k-12.s.s2.explain: '물어봤더니 ... -래요' = 'lapho ngibuza, (bathi) ...'. Umuntu obuziwe emugqeni owandulelayo ngu-비서.
k-12.s.s3.prompt: Kwenye ingxoxo, umugqa owodwa awucacile ukuthi kuhloselwe bani, nakuba isenzo sihloniphekile, ngoba abantu ababili abahlonishwayo basengxoxweni. Wukhethe.
k-12.s.s3.hint.0: Thola abantu engxoxweni abazokhulunywa ngabo nge--시-.
k-12.s.s3.hint.1: Kumugqa ngamunye, buza ukuthi isihloko siqanjiwe noma singaqagelwa kuphela.
k-12.s.s3.explain: U-'연락하신대요' unoku--시-, ngakho umuntu uyahlonishwa, kodwa kokubili u-사장님 no-팀장님 bafanelekile futhi imigqa yangaphambilini ibaqamba ndawonye. Umfundi akakwazi ukusho ukuthi ubani ozofonela futhi; ukwengeza isihloko ('사장님이 ...' noma '팀장님이 ...') kuyalungisa.
k-12.s.s4.prompt: Yenza ingxoxo yakho emibili yemigqa ngesiKorea (ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho) esimweni sesikole noma somsebenzi: othile ubuza ukuthi uthisha noma umphathi washo noma wenza ini, futhi impendulo ishiya isihloko kodwa ukuphela okuhloniphekile kusakhombisa ukuthi ubani.
k-12.s.s4.hint.0: Khetha umuntu ofanele ukuhlonishwa, njengo-선생님 noma 부장님.
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Umfundi angatshela ukuthi ubani owenzile ngaphandle kwesihloko?

k-01.title: 'Cha' engasho cha
k-01.goal: Phetha kusukela engxoxweni emfushane ukuthi impendulo ethambile yenqaba usuku olulodwa kodwa hhayi lonke uhlelo, khomba ubufakazi, bese ubhala ukwenqaba kwakho okuthambile unenye indlela.
k-01.material:
Abafundi ababili, 민수 no-수진, bathumelelana imilayezo. Basebenzisa ulimi lwe--요 olunenhlonipho. (😅 = ubuso obunethonsi elincane lokujuluka, ukumamatheka okuyinkinga.)

민수: 토요일에 영화 볼까요?
수진: 토요일은 좀… 😅
민수: 그럼 일요일은요?
수진: 일요일은 좋아요!
k-01.thinking.2: Ukukhiqiza impendulo ethambile kumfundi osebenza naye
k-01.prereq.1: Uyazi ukuphela okuyisisekelo kwe--아요/어요 namagama ezinsuku zesonto
k-01.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umugqa olandelayo ovela ku-민수: uphendula kanjani?
k-01.s.s1.hint.1: Qaphela ukuthi 수진 akasho 네 noma 아니요. Yini ayishiye ingaphelele?
k-01.s.s1.r.b: I-'좀…' ephela nge-emoji engabaza iwukungabaza, hhayi injabulo. Bheka ukuthi umugqa olandelayo (그럼 일요일은요?) uphendula kanjani.
k-01.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kufunda okuningi kakhulu. Umugqa wakhe wokugcina, 일요일은 좋아요!, ukhombisa ukuthi usafuna ukuya.
k-01.s.s1.r.d: Uphendula umbuzo ngqo ngokuqamba usuku, ngakho uwuqondile.
k-01.s.s1.explain: I-'좀…' ithambisa ukunqaba ukuze kungabikho odinga ukusho '안 돼요'. Uphawu lwesihloko -은 ku-'토요일은' lukhetha uMgqibelo, futhi 민수 uphendula ngokunikeza olunye usuku.
k-01.s.s2.prompt: Yiziphi izingcezu zobufakazi ezikhombisa ukuthi 수진 usafuna ukubuka ifilimu? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
k-01.s.s2.hint.0: Thola imigqa lapho asho okuthile okuhle.
k-01.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa lokho ayiqamba ku-'토요일은 좀…' nalokho ayiqamba ku-'일요일은 좋아요!'.
k-01.s.s2.o.a: Uphendula '일요일은 좋아요!' lapho 민수 enikeza iSonto.
k-01.s.s2.r.b: I-'좀' ithambisa ukunqaba; ayisho lutho ngokuthi uyawuthanda yini uhlelo.
k-01.s.s2.r.c: I-emoji ikhombisa ukuthi uzizwa engahlalisekile, hhayi ukuthi ufuna ifilimu.
k-01.s.s2.o.d: Wathi '토요일은', eqamba usuku kuphela, hhayi ifilimu uqobo.
k-01.s.s2.explain: Akaze anqabe ifilimu. Unqaba kuphela uMgqibelo (토요일은), futhi wamukela iSonto.
k-01.s.s2.acc.0: Ukucaphuna ubufakazi obucacile kuphela (wamukela iSonto) kunengqondo; d yengeza ukuthi uqamba usuku kuphela, hhayi ifilimu.
k-01.s.s3.prompt: Umfundi osebenza naye 민수 ukumemela ukudla ngaphandle ngoMgqibelo, kodwa awukwazi ukuya. Phendula ngesiKorea ngenkulumo ye--요: ungasho '싫어요', thambisa ukunqaba, bese unikeza olunye usuku.
k-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokuxolisa noma ngokuthi kuyisigejane, bese uqamba uMgqibelo.
k-01.s.s3.hint.1: Xolisa noma unikeze isizathu esifushane, bese uqeda ngombuzo ophakamisa olunye usuku.
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe impendulo yami yenza kucace ukuthi angikwazi ukwenza uMgqibelo?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe 민수 angazi ukuthi enzeni ngokulandelayo?
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Imfushane futhi ethambile; isebenzisa i-좀 futhi inikeza usuku.
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inikeza isizathu esikhundleni se-좀, bese iphakamisa iSonto.

k-02.title: Ukukhuluma nomabhalane wesitolo
k-02.goal: Qaphela imigqa yamakhasimende eyensuku zonke kakhulu kumuntu ongamaziyo esitolo, nquma ukuthi kungani, bese uyibhala kabusha ngenhlonipho.
k-02.material: Esitolo sezithelo. Umabhalane nekhasimende abazani. Bobabili babukeka bengabantu abadala.
k-02.s.s1.prompt: Umugqa owodwa noma ngaphezulu wekhasimende uzwakala wensuku zonke kakhulu ukukhuluma nomabhalane ongamaziyo. Khetha owodwa kubo.
k-02.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuphela komugqa ngamunye wekhasimende: iphela nge--요/-습니다?
k-02.s.s1.explain: I-'얼마야?' ne-'줘' yi-반말 (inkulumo yensuku zonke). Abantu ababangaziwa ngokuvamile basebenzisa inkulumo enenhlonipho komunye nomunye: '얼마예요?' ne-'주세요'.
k-02.s.s2.prompt: Umabhalane usebenzisa inkulumo enenhlonipho (-요) kukhasimende. Ingabe ikhasimende lingaphendula ngenkulumo yensuku zonke (반말) ngenxa yalokho?
k-02.s.s2.hint.0: Buza: ingabe laba bantu ababili bayazana?
k-02.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ikhasimende liyisihambi ebhasini. Uzosebenzisa izinga lolimi luni?
k-02.s.s2.o.a: Cha. Abantu abangaziwa basebenzisa inkulumo enenhlonipho ngezindlela zombili; umabhalane unenhlonipho njengengxenye yomsebenzi.
k-02.s.s2.o.b: Yebo. Bobabili abantu abadala bayakhuluma, ngakho inkulumo yensuku zonke ilungile.
k-02.s.s2.r.b: Ukuba umuntu omdala akwenzi inkulumo yensuku zonke ilunge; nomuntu ongamaziyo inkambiso ephephile inkulumo enenhlonipho ngezindlela zombili.
k-02.s.s2.o.c: Yebo. Ikhasimende liyakhokha, ngakho ikhasimende linquma.
k-02.s.s2.r.c: Ukukhokha akushintshi ubudlelwano. Amakhasimende nawo ngokuvamile asebenzisa inkulumo enenhlonipho.
k-02.s.s2.o.d: Cha, kodwa kungoba umabhalane mdala kakhulu.
k-02.s.s2.r.d: Iminyaka ingabalulekile, kodwa lapha iminyaka ayinikeziwe. Isizathu esiyinhloko ukuthi abazani.
k-02.s.s2.explain: Inkambiso phakathi kwabangaziwa inkulumo enenhlonipho ngezindlela zombili. Ezitolo, inkulumo enenhlonipho yomabhalane ulimi lwenkonzo futhi ayinikezi ikhasimende lungelo lokusebenzisa i-반말.
k-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala kabusha imigqa emibili yensuku zonke yekhasimende ('이 귤 얼마야?' ne-'그럼 두 봉지 줘.') ukuze ifanele lesi simo.
k-02.s.s3.hint.0: Shintsha ukuphela kwemigqa yomibili ibe yifomu elinenhlonipho.
k-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ngalokho okusho uma uyalela ekhefi.
k-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe yomibili imisho yami iphela ngenhlonipho?
k-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umabhalane engimazi ngeke azizwe ehlonishwa?

k-03.title: Ingabe izikhathi ziyahambisana?
k-03.goal: Qhathanisa isaziso esifushane nombhalo womngane, uqaphele ukuthi izikhathi azihambisani, futhi ubuze umbuzo omuhle wokucacisa esikhundleni sokuvuma.
k-03.material:
Namuhla uLwesihlanu, 10월 23일. Isikole sakho sinesaziso futhi umngane wakho ukuthumelele umbhalo.

[소풍 안내]
- 날짜: 10월 24일 토요일
- 장소: 한강공원
- 버스 출발: 아침 8시 30분 (학교 앞)
- 준비물: 도시락, 물, 편한 신발

친구 문자: "내일 7시에 학교 앞에서 만나요! 도시락 꼭 가져와요."
k-03.thinking.1: Ukunquma ukuthi ubuze ini ngaphambi kokuphendula
k-03.s.s1.prompt: Ngaphambi kokuphendula, ngumuphi umbuzo osiza kakhulu ukubuza umngane wakho?
k-03.s.s1.hint.0: Thola zonke izikhathi esazisweni nasembhalweni, bese uziqhathanisa.
k-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ngumuphi umbuzo obuza ngokuthile ONGAKWAZI kakade esazisweni?
k-03.s.s1.r.a: Isaziso sesikutshele kakade isikhathi sebhasi, ngakho lo mbuzo awungezi lutho.
k-03.s.s1.r.c: Umbhalo usho kuphela ukuthi ulethe ibhokisi lokudla; lapho ukuthenga kungeyona inkinga.
k-03.s.s1.r.e: Ukubuza i-AM noma i-PM kungaba isinyathelo sokuqala, kodwa ibhasi lihamba ekuseni, ngakho umhlangano kusihlwa awunangqondo. Inkinga yangempela igebe phakathi kwesikhathi sebhasi nesikhathi somhlangano.
k-03.s.s1.explain: Imithombo emibili iyahluka (isaziso sithi ibhasi lihamba ngo-8:30, umbhalo uthi hlangana ngo-7:00). Umbuzo ongcono ukhomba umehluko ukuze umngane achaze.
k-03.s.s1.acc.0: Ukubuza i-AM/PM kuyindlela enengqondo yokucacisa kuqala, kodwa akukakhombisi ukuthi uqaphele isikhathi sebhasi sika-8:30.
k-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umbuzo wakho kumngane wakho ngesiKorea (inkulumo yobungane nge--요). Qaphela kokubili isikhathi sebhasi (noma isaziso) nomhlangano wango-7:00.
k-03.s.s2.hint.0: Beka isikhathi sebhasi nesikhathi somngane wakho eceleni komunye emshweni owodwa.
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umbuzo wami ukhombisa ukuthi ngiqaphele ukuthi izikhathi ezimbili ziyehluka?
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe umngane wami angawuphendula ngomusho owodwa omfushane?

k-04.title: Ukuthenga ngemikhawulo
k-04.goal: Guqula umlayezo omfushane wombhalo onamagama alahliwe ube yimikhawulo eqondile, uthole amabhasikidi amaningi okuthenga ayanelisa, bese ubika oyedwa ngesiKorea.
k-04.material:
Umngane wakho ukuthumelela umbhalo ngaphambi kokuya emakethe:

"시장에 가요? 그럼 사과랑 귤 좀 사 와요. 만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요. 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요. 모두 5봉지 이상이요."

[가격표]
사과 한 봉지: 2,000원
귤 한 봉지: 1,000원
k-04.prereq.2: Uhlangane ne--까지 (kuze kube), -보다 (kune-) ne-이상 (le nombolo noma ngaphezulu); zichazwa ezinkombeni
k-04.s.s1.prompt: I-'만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요' ikutshela ini?
k-04.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi umngane wakho wayengacasuka yini uma uchitha ama-won angu-8,000.
k-04.s.s1.o.a: Ungachitha kuze kube ama-won angu-10,000 kodwa hhayi ngaphezulu.
k-04.s.s1.r.b: I-'까지' ibeka umkhawulo, hhayi inani eliqondile.
k-04.s.s1.r.c: Lokho bekungaba okuphambene: okuncane esikhundleni sokuphezulu.
k-04.s.s1.r.d: Amanani asohlwini lwamanani; i-만 원 yimali ongayisebenzisa.
k-04.s.s1.explain: I-'-까지' ikhombisa umkhawulo ophezulu: kuze kube ama-won angu-10,000, futhi ukuchitha okuncane kulungile.
k-04.s.s2.prompt: Thola amabhasikidi angu-3 afanelana nazo zonke izimo zomlayezo, ngalinye linenani elihlukile lezikhwama zama-apula. a = izikhwama zama-apula, g = izikhwama zamatangerine.
k-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala izimo ngamazwi akho kuqala: '-보다 많아야 해요' = kumele kube kuningi kune-; '이상' = le nombolo noma ngaphezulu.
k-04.s.s2.hint.1: Zama a = 1 bese wengeza g kuze kube yilapho isamba sifinyelela ezikhwameni ezi-5.
k-04.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola imali ekugcineni: 2,000 × a + 1,000 × g, bese ushintsha a.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Umlayezo ucela kokubili 사과 ne-귤 (okungenani isikhwama esisodwa ngasinye).
k-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요: izikhwama zamatangerine kumele zibe zimningi kunezikhwama zama-apula.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c3: 모두 5봉지 이상: okungenani izikhwama ezi-5 sekukonke.
k-04.s.s2.explain: Isibonelo i-apula eli-1 + amatangerine ama-4 = ama-won angu-6,000; 2 + 3 = ama-won angu-7,000; 3 + 4 = ama-won angu-10,000. Amabhasikidi amaningi ayafaneleka ngoba umlayezo unikeza imikhawulo, hhayi umyalelo oyedwa ngqo.
k-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha ibhasikidi LOKUQALA lakho bese uthumela umngane wakho umbhalo omfushane wesiKorea (-요 enenhlonipho) osho ukuthi uthenge izikhwama ezingaki zesithelo ngasinye nesamba.
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sebenzisa ibhasikidi elilodwa ongenhla: yiziphi izinombolo ezimbili?
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sho inani lama-apula, inani lamatangerine, bese isamba nge-won.
k-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe izinombolo zombhalo wami zihambisana nebhasikidi elilodwa engilakhile?

k-05.s.s1.prompt: Funda ingxenye ngayinye, khetha ukufunda okubonakala kunokwenzeka kakhulu, bese uqhubeka.
k-05.title: Umakhelwane usho ini?
k-05.goal: Buyekeza ukufunda kwakho kokukhalaza okungaqondile njengoba ingxenye eyengeziwe yengxoxo ivela, bese ubhala inothi elifanele umakhelwane.
k-05.material: Uhlala efulethini 302. Umuntu omdala ovela efulethini 202 (ifulethi elingezansi), omazi kancane, uyakumisa ku-elevator.
k-05.thinking.1: Ukubuyekeza ukuhumusha njengoba ingxoxo eyengeziwe iboniswa
k-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bheka ukuphela kwemisho (…, -서요, -는데) ukuthola lokho okungashiwongo.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuleli nqubo, kokubili ingxoxo encane nokubonisa inkinga kungenzeka, kodwa i-'들려서요…' iphela ngesizathu futhi ishiya umphumela ungashiwo, okuvame ukuba uphawu lwesikhalazo.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Akukho emushweni okukhomba ukuthuthela; umakhelwane owayefuna lokho ubeyoqonda kakhulu.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Akukho ulimi lwesimemo (njenge-놀러 오세요). Umusho ukhuluma ngemisindo ehlupha isikhulumi.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Umntwana ungowobani, futhi umakhelwane unethemba lini?
k-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Okhulumayo uyeqa umnikazi, kodwa ingane eyivuka ngenxa yomsindo ovela ngaphezulu iyendlu yomakhelwane. Bathemba umsindo omncane, hhayi ukuthi uhambe.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ingane yabo uqobo; bathemba ukuthi umsindo wakusihlwa uzokwehliswa
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ingane yilona evuka ngenxa yomsindo ovela ngaphezulu, ngakho ingeyakhulumayo, hhayi eyakho.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ithemba lomkhulumi limayelana nomsindo, hhayi nalapho uhlala khona; akukho uphawu lokuthi bafuna uthuthe.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ingane yomuntu ongekho; kuyinkulumo encane nje
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Imininingwane ngengane (자는데, 깨서요) iyisizathu sesicelo, ngakho lokhu kungaphezu kwenkulumo encane.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.after: U-'아니에요, 감사해요' no-'좀 부탁드려요' kubonisa isicelo esithule, esinenhlonipho esikhawulelwe ngemva kuka-9 p.m.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Akathukuthele; wamukela uhlelo lwakho bese ecela ukuthula ngemva kuka-9
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: U-'아니에요, 감사해요' iphimbo elithulile, elibongayo, hhayi elithukuthele.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ufuna izingane ziyeke ukugijima ngezikhathi zonke
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Bacela kuphela ngemva kuka-9 ('9시 이후만'), hhayi ukungagijimi ngezikhathi zonke.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Basasho u-'부탁드려요', ngakho ukuthula ngemva kuka-9 kubalulekile kubo.
k-05.s.s1.reflect: Qaphela ukuthi isikhalo singakhiwa kanjani ngezinkomba ezincane: kuqala umusho ongaphelele, bese isizathu, bese isicelo. Inhlonipho ayisho ukuthi akukho sicelo.
k-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngosuku olulandelayo ushiya inothi elifushane (쪽지) emnyango womakhelwane. Xolisa, sho ukuthi uzokwenzani, futhi ubonge. Sebenzisa ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho.
k-05.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngenombolo yefulethi lakho, bese ukuxolisa.
k-05.s.s2.hint.1: Qamba isikhathi (njengo-9시 이후) noma indlela yokuziphatha ozoyishintsha.
k-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isethembiso sami siqondile (isikhathi noma indlela yokuziphatha)?
k-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngangizozwa kahle uma umakhelwane engibhalela lokhu?

k-10.title: Lesi sicelo siqine kangakanani?
k-10.goal: Buyekeza ukufunda kwakho isicelo sasemsebenzini esithambisiwe njengoba imilayezo eyengeziwe ivela, bese ubhala impendulo eqinisekisa lokho ozokwenza nokuthi nini.
k-10.material: 팀장 wakho (umholi weqembu, umphathi wakho) uthumela imilayezo ku-chat yenkampani. Yifunde ngayinye.
k-10.s.s1.prompt: Funda umlayezo ngamunye, khetha ukuthi ungawuqonda kanjani, bese uqhubeka.
k-10.s.s1.hint.1: Buza ukuthi ubani okhuluma nobani nokuthi umphathi uvame ukulindela ini.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Kumphathi, u-'혹시 ... 주실 수 있을까요?' ngokuvamile yindlela enenhlonipho yokucela into yenziwe. Ukuwufunda ngokwenkulumo njengombuzo mayelana nesikhathi sakho samahhala kungenzeka ekuqaleni, kodwa imilayezo elandelayo ikhombisa ukuthi isicelo sangempela.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Isicelo esithambile kodwa sangempela esivela kumphathi; uyalindeleke ukuthi usenze
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Isicelo somphathi sikhetheke kakhulu; izithambisi (혹시, 시간 되면) zigcina kuphela inhlonipho.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Alikho igama elifana no-지금 noma 당장 elivelayo, ngakho akuwona umyalo ongokushesha.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.after: U-'-까지만 보면 돼요' useta umkhawulo: ngaphambi komhlangano wakusasa. U-'급한 건 아니고요' usho kuphela ukuthi akukho ngozi.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: U-'내일 오전 회의 전까지만' useta umkhawulo oqine kakhulu kune-'leli sonto'.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: U-'급한 건 아니고요' usho ukuthi akuphuthumi, ngakho hhayi manje.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: U-'전까지' usho ngaphambi komhlangano, hhayi ngemuva.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.after: U-'더 좋고요' isifiso, hhayi umthetho, kodwa izifiso zomphathi ziyabalulekile. Hlela ukubheka namuhla noma uhlole ngenhlonipho ukuthi isifiso siqine kangakanani.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ungenzi lutho kuze kube sekuseni, usuku lokugcina umhlangano
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Lokhu kuhlangabezana nosuku lokugcina olushiwo kodwa kunganaki isifiso esisha sika-namuhla ('더 좋고요'); isifiso somphathi ngokuvamile siyabalwa.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Zama ukukubheka ngaphambi kokuhamba namuhla, bese uqeda ngaphambi komhlangano
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ungawanaki umlayezo omusha, usuku lokugcina lokuqala lungolangempela
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Umlayezo omusha wengeza kowokuqala; awukuchithi, futhi isifiso somphathi siyabalulekile.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Phendula ubuze ukuthi ukubheka namuhla kuyadingeka noma kuyamukelekile kuphela
k-10.s.s1.reflect: Isicelo esithambisiwe somphathi ngokuvamile sisalindelekile ukuthi senziwe. Imilayezo yakamuva ngokuvamile yengeza usuku lokugcina langempela; umusho othambile kakhulu awufani no-'okungakhethwa'.
k-10.s.s2.prompt: Phendula u-팀장님 ku-chat ngokukhuluma okunenhlonipho. Qinisekisa ukuthi uzokwenza futhi usho nini.
k-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngisho ngokucacile ukuthi ngizokwenzani nangasiphi isikhathi?

k-06.title: Ingabe umngani wami angathola ukubuyiselwa kwemali?
k-06.goal: Hlanganisa isaziso, itafula nomyalezo womngani ukunquma ukuthi kusebenza ukubuyiselwa kwemali okungakanani, khomba ubufakazi obudingekayo, bese ukuchazela umngani ngesiKorea.
k-06.s.s1.prompt: Umngani wakho angathola ukubuyiselwa kwemali okungakanani?
k-06.s.s1.hint.0: Sebenza engxenyeni yesithathu nengxenye yamalesoni angu-8.
k-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa amalesoni angu-3 omngani wakho nalezo zinombolo ezimbili.
k-06.s.s1.r.a: Ukubuyiselwa okuphelele kusebenza kuphela ngaphambi kokuqala kwesifundo. Umngani wakho usevele ehambele amalesoni angu-3.
k-06.s.s1.r.b: Izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zisebenza ngaphambi kokuthi ingxenye yesithathu yamalesoni idlule. U-3 kwangu-8 ungaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu (cishe 2.7).
k-06.s.s1.r.d: Akukho kubuyiselwa kusebenza kuphela ngemva kokuthi ingxenye (4 kwangu-8) idlulile. Umngani wakho unalo kuphela ama-3.
k-06.s.s1.explain: Amalesoni angu-3 kwangu-8 angaphezu kwengxenye yesithathu (8 ÷ 3 ≈ 2.7) kodwa angaphansi kwengxenye (4). Ngakho umugqa othi 'ngaphambi kokuthi ingxenye idlule' uyasebenza: ukubuyiselwa kwengxenye.
k-06.s.s2.prompt: Yiziphi izingcezu zolwazi obuzidingile ukufinyelela kuleyo mpendulo?
k-06.s.s2.r.c: Lokho kusho kuphela ukuthi ungafaka kanjani isicelo, hhayi ukuthi kubuyiselwa malini.
k-06.s.s2.explain: Itafula linikeza izingxenye zesifundo sonke, ngakho udinga isamba (8) nenani osevele lihanjelwe (3). Indlela yokufaka isicelo nesizathu akudingeki enanini.
k-06.s.s2.acc.0: Ukwazi ukuthi ufaka kanjani isicelo kuyasiza esinyathelweni esilandelayo, kodwa akushintshi inani lokubuyiselwa kwemali.
k-06.s.s3.prompt: Phendula umngani wakho ngesiKorea: sho ukuthi kubuyiselwa malini, unikeze isizathu esivela ezinombolweni, futhi umtshele ukuthi enzeni ngokulandelayo. Ukukhuluma okungasemthethweni noma okunenhlonipho kokubili kulungile.
k-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nikeza impendulo kuqala, bese isizathu ngezinombolo.
k-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe ngisho ukuthi kungani kuyingxenye, hhayi ukuphelele noma lutho?
k-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngiqambe ukuthi ungafaka kanjani isicelo?

k-07.title: Isicelo esifanayo, abalaleli ababili
k-07.goal: Hlulela ukuthi yimuphi isicelo kuprofesa ongumyalo kunesicelo esiqhamukayo, bese ubhala isicelo esifanayo kuprofesa nakumngani osondelene.
k-07.material: Ugulile futhi waphuthelwa yiklasi likaLwesibili. Udinga ama-slide enkulumo. Uzocela uprofesa wakho ngomyalezo, futhi ucele nomfundi naye ongumngani wakho osondelene neminyaka efanayo.
k-07.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha incazelo efanayo yomlaleli ohlukile
k-07.prereq.1: Wazi u--아/어 주세요 no--(으)ㄹ 수 있어요
k-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zontathu zisemthethweni ngephimbo, ngakho qhathanisa okunye: ingabe umyalezo ngamunye ubuza noma utshela?
k-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi uprofesa ufunda umyalezo ngamunye: yimuphi ozwakala njengomyalo?
k-07.s.s1.r.a: Lokhu kufanele: u-'-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?' ungumbuzo othambile ushiya uprofesa isikhala sokuthi cha.
k-07.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kufanele: ubuza ukuthi kungenzeka yini esikhundleni sokutshela uprofesa ukuthi enze okuthile.
k-07.s.s1.r.d: Lokhu kufanele: u-'-(으)시면 감사하겠습니다' yindlela evamile esemthethweni yokwenza isicelo.
k-07.s.s1.explain: U-b utshela uprofesa ukuthi enzeni ('보내세요') futhi wengeza usuku lokugcina ('오늘 안에 꼭'); ungumyalo. Abanye bayabuza, bashiye uprofesa ekhululekile ukuphendula.
k-07.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wakho kuprofesa ucela ama-slide. Sho ukuthi kungani waphuthelwa yiklasi.
k-07.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenzisa isimo sombuzo esifana no-'-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?' ukuthambisa.
k-07.s.s3.prompt: Manje cela umngani wakho osondelene (iminyaka efanayo, usebenzisa 반말) into efanayo.
k-07.s.s3.hint.1: Gcina isizathu, kodwa ushiye izichazi zokuhlonipha.
k-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe lokhu kuzwakala njengokukhuluma nomngani hhayi uprofesa?

k-08.title: Isimemo okwakungesona
k-08.goal: Thola umugqa lapho ukubingelela kwathathwa njengesimemo sangempela, chaza ukuphendula komakhelwane, bese ulungisa impendulo.
k-08.material:
Uhlangana nomakhelwane ku-elevator. Nibingelelana ngezinye izikhathi kodwa anisondelene.

Ingxoxo:
k-08.s.s1.prompt: Ingxoxo yaba nokungakhululeki. Khetha umugqa oyingxenye yembangela: isisho esingafundwa ngezindlela ezimbili, impendulo eyenza yaba uhlelo, noma ukulandelela okuphushela uhlelo futhi.
k-08.s.s1.hint.0: Thola umugqa wokuqala lapho umuntu oyedwa eba qondile kuno-omunye.
k-08.s.s1.hint.1: Buza: ingabe kukhona isikhathi noma indawo emshweni womakhelwane uqobo?
k-08.s.s1.explain: U-'언제 밥 한번 먹어요' (umugqa 3) ukuvamile ukuba yisisho sokuvala sobungane, njengo-'ake sidle isidlo sasemini ngesinye isikhathi'. Umugqa 4 uthatha njengohlelo oluqondile futhi ubeka usuku. Ukungabaza komakhelwane (…, 글쎄요, 나중에) kubonisa ingcindezi. Umugqa 6 ('그럼 다음 주는요? 몇 시가 좋아요?') uphusha uhlelo futhi ngemva kokuba umakhelwane engabaza.
k-08.s.s2.prompt: Kungani umakhelwane aphendula u-'글쎄요…' no-'나중에 연락드릴게요'?
k-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ingabe kukhona isikhathi noma indawo emshweni womakhelwane?
k-08.s.s2.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi abantu baqeda kanjani inkulumo emfushane ku-elevator.
k-08.s.s2.o.a: Ukusho 'ake sidle ngesinye isikhathi' kwakuyisisho sobungane, futhi usuku olunqunyiwe luzwakala njengengcindezi.
k-08.s.s2.r.b: Akukho engxoxweni okusho lokho. Umakhelwane uhlala enenhlonipho njalo.
k-08.s.s2.r.c: Kungenzeka, kodwa umakhelwane owayefuna ngempela ukuhlangana wayezophakamisa elinye ilanga; iphimbo elingabaza, elingazibophi lihambisana kangcono nenhlonipho.
k-08.s.s2.explain: Amagama afanayo angaba yisimemo sangempela noma inhlonipho. Iphimbo nomongo (hhayi basondelene, ku-elevator, akukho sikhathi esiqanjiwe) bakhomba inhlonipho lapha.
k-08.s.s2.acc.0: Kungaba yiqiniso ukuthi umakhelwane ububekile, kodwa iphimbo elingabaza likuchazwa kangcono yinhlonipho.
k-08.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo engcono ku-'네. 언제 밥 한번 먹어요.' enobungane kodwa engabeki usuku.
k-08.s.s3.hint.0: Vuma ngendlela ejwayelekile ngaphandle kokuqamba usuku noma isikhathi.
k-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe impendulo yami ishiya umakhelwane ekhululekile ukusho yebo kamuva?

k-09.title: Ingaphuma ebusuku namuhla?
k-09.goal: Funda isaziso sesakhiwo esinohlu olufana netafula, nquma ukuthi yisiphi isigameko esishodayo esishintsha impendulo, hlola ikhophi yempendulo, bese ubhala impendulo ephelele komakhelwane omusha.
k-09.thinking.0: Ukunquma ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olushodayo olushintsha impendulo
k-09.s.s1.prompt: Ukunikeza impendulo EYODWA enembile ku-'Ngingakhipha lezi namuhla ebusuku?', yimuphi umbuzo odinga ukuwubuza umakhelwane kuqala?
k-09.s.s1.hint.0: Hamba ngento ngayinye (박스, 소파, 페트병) bese ubuza: ingabe impendulo yanamuhla icacile?
k-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kuyiphi into impendulo encike emininingwaneni umakhelwane angayinikezanga?
k-09.s.s1.r.b: Noma impendulo iyini, isofa ayikwazi ukuphuma namuhla ebusuku (ukuqoqwa kungoLwesine). Ungeluleka ukubika ngaphandle kokubuza.
k-09.s.s1.r.d: Amabhodlela angaphuma namuhla ebusuku noma kunjani; ungatshela umakhelwane ukuthi ahlanze futhi ahlambulule.
k-09.s.s1.explain: Iphepha liphuma ngoLwesibili (namuhla ebusuku kulungile), kodwa i-Styrofoam ingoLwesithathu (hhayi namuhla ebusuku). U-'박스' yedwa awusho ukuthi yiliphi. Ungaphendula futhi kokubili ngesikhathi esisodwa, kodwa lesi yisigameko sodwa esishintsha impendulo; isofa 'cha' noma kunjani.
k-09.s.s2.prompt: Ikhophi yempendulo ibhalwe isuselwa esaziseni. Khetha umugqa ongalungile.
k-09.s.s2.hint.0: Hlola umugqa ngamunye ngokumelene nomugqa ohambisanayo wetafula.
k-09.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka umugqa we-대형 폐기물: nini nokuthi kanjani?
k-09.s.s2.explain: Udoti omkhulu (소파) kumele ubikwe kuqala bese ubekwa ngosuku lokuqoqwa, uLwesine ngaphambi kuka-7 a.m., nesitikha esinamathiselwe. Ayikwazi ukuphuma namuhla ebusuku.
k-09.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo kumakhelwane wakho omusha (ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho) ehlanganisa zonke izinto ezintathu.
k-09.s.s3.hint.0: Thatha izinto eyodwa ngesikhathi: 페트병, 박스, 소파.
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.3: Ngisho ukuthi i-sofa kumele ibikwe ehhovisi kuqala futhi ithwale isitikha?

k-11.title: Ukuthi cha ezimemweni ezimbili
k-11.goal: Khetha ukwenqaba okwamukelekile kumphathi, bese ubhala ukwenqaba kumphathi nokuhlukile kozakwenu wezinga elifanayo.
k-11.material:
Namuhla unesivumelwano esinye. Izimemo ezimbili ziyafika.

팀장님: "오늘 저녁에 다 같이 회식하려고 하는데, 시간 되는 사람은 같이 가요."
입사 동기 (ozakwenu oqale naye ngasikhathi sinye, umngane osondele): "오늘 퇴근하고 치킨 먹을래?"
k-11.thinking.1: Ukubhala ukwenqaba okuthambisiwe kunesizathu nenye indlela
k-11.thinking.2: Ukubhala kabusha ukwenqaba okufanayo kubalaleli abahlukile
k-11.s.s1.prompt: Yikuphi ukwenqaba okungathunyelwa ku-팀장님? Khetha konke okufanele isimo.
k-11.s.s1.hint.0: Kumlayezo ngamunye, qaphela ukuthi uyaxolisa noma ukhombisa ukudabuka, unikeza isizathu, futhi uthambisa ngokuthile okufana no-'-ㄹ 것 같습니다'.
k-11.s.s1.hint.1: Khetha wonke umlayezo owenza okungenani izinto ezimbili zalokho ngendlela umphathi ayoyamukela.
k-11.s.s1.r.a: Ufanelekile (ukuxolisa, isizathu, isithambisi). Akuyona okuwukuphela okufanelekile, ngakho hlola nezinye izinketho.
k-11.s.s1.r.b: Ukuphela kusemthethweni, kodwa umlayezo uyisitatimende esilula: akukho kuxolisa, akukho kudabuka futhi akukho kuthambisa ('안 갑니다' ngu-'angiyi' ongacashile), okunzima kakhulu kumphathi.
k-11.s.s1.r.c: Ufanelekile (ukudabuka, isizathu, ukusemthethweni). Akuyona okuwukuphela okufanelekile, ngakho hlola nezinye izinketho.
k-11.s.s1.r.d: Ufanelekile (isizathu, isithambisi, isithembiso sesikhathi esizayo). Akuyona okuwukuphela okufanelekile, ngakho hlola nezinye izinketho.
k-11.s.s1.explain: U-a no-c bayaxolisa noma bakhombisa ukudabuka ('죄송하지만', '아쉽지만'), banikeza isizathu futhi bathambisa ukwenqaba. U-d unikeza isizathu, uthambisa nge-'못 갈 것 같습니다' futhi uthembisa isikhathi esizayo. U-b usho kuphela ukwenqaba okulula ('안 갑니다') ngakho uzwakala unzima noma ukuphela kusemthethweni.
k-11.s.s1.acc.0: Kokubili kuyafaneleka; u-d wengeza futhi isithembiso sesikhathi esizayo, ngakho ukukhetha zontathu kuyimpendulo ephelele kakhulu.
k-11.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ukwenqaba kwakho ku-팀장님. Sebenzisa ukukhuluma okunenhlonipho/okusemthethweni, kuthambise, unikeze isizathu futhi usho isikhathi esizayo.
k-11.s.s2.hint.0: Vula ngokuxolisa noma ukubonga, bese isizathu.
k-11.s.s3.prompt: Manje yenqaba isimemo sika-동기 se-chicken ngokukhuluma okungajwayelekile. Gcina kunobungane futhi uphakamise esinye isikhathi.
k-11.s.s3.hint.0: Fushanisa umusho bese ulahla ukuphela okusemthethweni.
